parts:
Hi all,

I'm planning for 0.9.1 release in the near future - the aim is to fix
bugs introduced in 0.9.0. I'd like to keep new features to a minimum
so we can release soon (the facet_grid bug is particularly bad).
Classes end for me on April 20, so I'm hoping I can get most of the
bugs fixed by the end of the following week. I'll then let package
maintainers know (and run R CMD check on them myself), and give them
two weeks to fix any problems, aiming for a release around May 9.

I'm hoping this release can include Winston's fixes to polar coordinates

Hadley
